_comment: Engine constants for the Kiro workflow definition format, read verbatim
out of the shipped KAS bundle. THIS FILE IS THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH:
the Nix option types and the Effect-TS schema both consume it, so the two
deliverables cannot drift apart from each other. They can still drift from
the ENGINE — see verifiedAgainst, and re-derive on every kiro-cli bump.
Re-derivation (bash, not zsh - `shopt` is not a zsh builtin):
ver=$(kiro-cli --version | awk '{print $NF}')
shopt -s nullglob
kasdirs=( "$HOME/.local/share/kiro-cli/kas/${ver}-"*/ )
[ "${#kasdirs[@]}" -eq 1 ] || { echo refuse; exit 1; }
b="${kasdirs[0]}node_modules/@kiro/agent/dist/server/acp-server.js"
command grep -boF 'DEFAULT_MAX_STEP_NODES' "$b"
The bundle is ~21 MB. Never cat it; use byte-offset windows only.
REGEX ANCHORING: watch.crIdPattern is stored UNANCHORED on purpose, because
the two consumers anchor differently and neither spelling is portable.
Nix `builtins.match` is whole-string by definition, so it uses the pattern
verbatim; the TypeScript side must wrap it as `^...$` before testing. Do
NOT add ^ or $ here — Nix would then require a literal caret in the value.
Character classes are written [0-9] rather than \d so both languages read
the same thing (JS \d without the u flag is [0-9], but that is a fact you
would have to know rather than see).
